question.text: Which of the following compounds will have the highest melting point here?

solution.text: Compound II is most symmetrical because it has both <math><mtext>C</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>H</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> groups and Br atoms are apposite to each other therefore, it fits in the crystal lattice better than the other two isomers and hence it has high melting point.
